content.title: What counts as an "active listing" if I'm not accepting guests?
content.summary: If your property is searchable or has an "active" status on any rental platform, it is considered an advertisement, and you are required to obtain an STR permit and a active business license. The Short Term Rental Ordinance (3-1-5-3(R)(1) strictly prohibits advertising an STR without an STR permit.
